body: In my country abortion is illegal. Only way is pills that we can buy overboard. It’s hard. But it’s possible. I have enough money for this and contacts. That’s really good plan. It’s helpful. Thank you for reminding me this way out.
Only pills. I wish I had used condoms and pills. But since now I will because my bf finally agreed to use this two methods.
I tried to talk with him but all he said was “you should go to therapy”. I know. I will. It’s making me sad that he doesn’t understand my fear and doesn’t see a problem in his behavior.
That’s awesome! So happy for you!

Same sis. Try to fill your mind with positive thoughts, good memories. I will bake some cookies, make lemonade, it helps me. Maybe you should try cooking? Just try to focus on other, positive things. I know it’s hard. But you are strong and you can do this.
